name: Tam Hunt
abstract_title: General Resonance Theory 2.0: The Evolutionary History and Mechanisms of Electromagnetic Field-Based Consciousness
abstract: The study of consciousness continues to challenge traditional paradigms in neuroscience and philosophy, as it seeks to explain the emergence of subjective experience from biological processes. General Resonance Theory 2.0 (GRT 2.0) advances the original General Resonance Theory (Hunt & Schooler, 2019; Hunt, 2020) by embedding its core principles within an evolutionary context, drawing on insights from comparative neuroscience, bioelectric signaling, and metabolic biology.
